wiki.title: Lori Wilson (California politician)
wiki.extract: Lori Denise Wilson (born July 17, 1976) is an American politician elected to the California State Assembly. She is a Democrat elected to represent the 11th district, encompassing Solano County and parts of Contra Costa County, including the city of Oakley, and Sacramento County. Prior to being elected to the State Assembly, she was mayor of Suisun City.
